title: PI plan — tranche 4 (retrospective, authorised 2026-11-22)
body:
# PI plan — tranche 4

## Objectives

Every project in tranche 4 (S05, S07, S09, T10, T14, T16, T4, T9) carries a **green manifest at
one snapshot**: its charter, frozen baseline, A–D set, contract, Phase-G review, declared
outputs and closure chain recorded through the product's actions, with the close decided by an
approver distinct from the requester. The six closed projects are re-verified, not re-planned;
T4 and T9 are delivered before the tranche review, and T10 was closed on 2026-11-22 as this
plan's first delivered objective.

## Plan

| Batch | Work | Exit |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | T10 factory and closure (WBS, registers, nine artefact categories, Phase-G review, closure review, closure gate, destructive gate, close) | done 2026-11-22: closed v13, manifest re-rendered |
| 2 | T4 factory: the change-control row, baseline, compliance review, the nine mandatory documents, closure chain | T4 closed with a green manifest |
| 3 | T9 factory: the same set, plus its ADM delivery review | T9 closed with a green manifest |
| 4 | S05, S07, S09, T14, T16: closure reviews and the P0 std-* packages for each | audit `--rework-check` cleared per package |
| 5 | The tr4 review: baselines, benefit status, the risk register, the snapshot SHA | continue, pause or stop recorded; the successor authorised |

## WSJF order

Computed from the four integers the WBS rows carry, highest first:
T4 = (8+7+8)/5 = 4.6 · T10 = (8+7+8)/8 = 2.875 · T9 = (13+8+13)/13 = 2.615.
The closed S-projects carry no open WBS node and take batch 4's record work, not a re-plan.

## Capacity and WIP

One record writer at a time (the staging copy at migration 75 has one holder); one Rust build or
test suite at a time on the shared box; WIP is one project's closure chain — the chain writes the
closure gate, the destructive gate and the close, and a second writer would race the gate reads.

## Evidence

The per-project acceptance manifests (`acceptance/programme/<KEY>.toml`) executed by
`scripts/verify-project.py` at a fresh full-fidelity snapshot; the P0 rework cards receipted and
delivered; the closure review document published; the Phase-G review recorded against the live
contract citing the standing delegation.

## Dependencies

The register-quality batch (ADR re-key, owned risks, benefit records) and the promote-record
grammar extension (the closure kinds) are the tranche's upstream; T9's ADM capability is the
contract the later design gates depend on; the staging copy at migration 75 and the branch
binary are the transport until the merge deploys.

## Backlog refinement

The refinement pass found and delivered stale P0 cards whose work was already done
(`v1-w2b-2:T10`, `v1-p82-1:T10`, `pi_plan_missing:tranche-2`): a resolved finding or a published
plan must be receipted on the card, never re-done. Rows whose findings are resolved but whose
cards are open are this pass's target; an unresolved finding stays a work package.
